summary: Notes panels keep their dragged size across restarts and window sizes instead of sometimes opening at the minimum width.
details: The size is now a desktop preference, so File > Restart, Clear Cache & Reload, and a fallback app port no longer forget it.
Adjusting only the height no longer resets the width to the minimum, and a height adjustment in a window too narrow for the panel keeps the wider width for when the window is maximized.
